Info

Compiles auxiliary hardware commands (PUMP, VALVE, WAIT, HOME, MOTOR) into binary frames and steps.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.binary.command.command_compiler.CommandCompiler(*, frame_builder: IBinaryFrameBuilder, tool_frame_builder: IToolFrameBuilder, motor_frame_builder: IMotorFrameBuilder, token_parser: ICommandTokenParser)[source]¶

Bases: object

Compiles semantic hardware commands into binary wire frames and binary steps.

It defines:

attributes:
_frame_builder - Binary frame assembler protocol.
_tool_frame_builder - Tool frame builder protocol.
_motor_frame_builder - Motor frame builder protocol.
_token_parser - Waypoint command token parser protocol.

compile_command_step - Compiles a single hardware command into a binary step.
get_version - Gets implementation version string.

compile_command_step(*, command: str, seq_num: int, line_num: int) → Step[source]¶

Compiles a semantic command string into a binary command step.

Parameters:

  • command – Command text (e.g. PUMP, VALVE, WAIT, HOME, MOTOR).

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence counter.

  • line_num – Source line index.

Returns:

Compiled Step.

Exceptions:

ScaraSemanticError on unsupported command name.
